en-US.name: Rea-Video
en-US.summary: Analyze shots, editing and audio with frame illustrations and slow motion. Install the Rea-Video CLI, Python 3.10+ and FFmpeg separately. The updated CLI requires videomd 1.2+. Optional vision or remake providers require setup and approval before uploads or paid calls.
en-US.description:
Break down shots, edits, subtitles and audio, then get a remake plan. The market installs the upstream instructions and references. For the CLI, use the [upstream setup guide](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/blob/131d1527557d2cccacb64059d47560964235acd7/skills/rea-video/references/setup.md) and install from the catalog commit for matching output. Confirm `rea-video --help`, `ffmpeg -version` and `ffprobe -version` before analyzing a clip. Local processing may download audio models on first use.

Optional visual analysis sends shot clips or keyframes to your configured provider. Verify the endpoint, credentials and authorization before enabling it. Provider terms and usage fees apply. When the connection is unavailable, run locally and flag low-confidence findings. Remakes through capsule-cinema require a configured local deployment and model access. ChatCut requires a separate account and paid access for generation. Check availability and costs before using either. The analysis and remake plan can be produced locally.

[中文说明](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/blob/131d1527557d2cccacb64059d47560964235acd7/i18n/README_zh.md)

zh-CN.name: Rea-Video 视频拆解
zh-CN.summary: 逐镜拆解画面、剪辑和声音，输出关键时刻图解与慢放。需另装 Rea-Video CLI、Python 3.10+ 和 FFmpeg（新版 CLI 依赖 videomd 1.2+）；视觉分析与复刻服务另配，上传或计费前需用户确认。
zh-CN.description:
分析镜头、剪辑、字幕和声音，并给出复刻方案。市场安装上游技能说明和参考资料。CLI 请按[上游安装说明](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/blob/131d1527557d2cccacb64059d47560964235acd7/skills/rea-video/references/setup.md)另装，使用市场固定的提交可保持输出一致。拆解前运行 `rea-video --help`、`ffmpeg -version` 和 `ffprobe -version` 确认环境。本地处理首次运行可能下载音频模型。

启用可选视觉模型会把镜头片段或关键帧发给配置的服务商。启用前核对端点、凭据和素材传输授权，费用及使用条款以服务商为准。连接不可用时可本地拆解，并标注低置信度结论。使用 capsule-cinema 复刻需自行部署并配置模型。ChatCut 需单独注册，生成需付费权限。调用前确认服务可用及费用，拆解和复刻方案可在本地完成。

[上游中文说明](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/blob/131d1527557d2cccacb64059d47560964235acd7/i18n/README_zh.md)
